verdicts.reason: A breaks the hierarchy: the 'Build Your Mix' CTA has shrunk to a chip-sized pill jammed into the top-left corner, mixed in with the reordered botanical chips, and it collides with the logo zone, which is pushed off-centre to the right. The headline wraps to leave 'glow.' orphaned on its own line, and the bottom ~30% of the canvas is dead space. B keeps the original's centred stack and reading order (logo, can, headline, chips, CTA, legal) with the CTA clearly prominent; its only flaws are that the logo and legal line are a bit small and the layout is closer to a scaled copy than a reworked one, with slightly heavy empty space at the bottom.
